residuals.summary: Product evidence is limited to win32-x64; macOS and Linux were not executed.
Only deterministic probe models were exercised; broader model families and external model quality were not measured.
Repository-language coverage is limited to fixture languages; unlisted languages remain unmeasured.
F3 proves semantic identity across two builds but not byte-identical provider reproducibility.
The provider conflicts-plan seam remains unavailable and is not promoted by this acceptance.
Cleanup is proven for observed normal, failure, continuation, restart and interruption paths, not arbitrary power-loss/crash recovery.
